notes.title: Languages support added to the demo!
notes.notes:
[p]You can now play Cardburners in \[language]

As the game is still in development, and things are changing fast, we added temporary auto-translations so more people can enjoy the demo.

We are working with translators for the full version and all definiteive texts.

Please share Cardburners, challenge your friends and let us knwo what you think of Cardburners![/p]

notes.title: New demo available!
notes.notes:
[p]We reworked the tutorial, so it's a bit less overwhelming, so tell your friends to have another go if it was too much before!

We also improve stability and balance a lot!

Please keep sending us feedback on [url="https://discord.com/invite/FNW93c7yUn"]discord[/url] and steam, we'll update the demo as we go from your feedback.

And we are entering the last big chunk of content work for the full version of the game, that's a lot more pack, cards, opponents and mechanics too add!!

So now is time to get the word out and speak about cardburners everywhere!!

Thank you
GrosChevaux[/p]
